descriptionEn: Offered for sale: an apartment with an area of 76m² net, located in the Apolonia A19 complex, on Rruga Hysen Xhakolli, near Kafe Plus Minus.
The apartment was built by “Tregtia”, is located on the 2nd floor and has a view of Rruga Dardania.
The property was originally laid out as a 2+1 apartment, but it has been redesigned as a 1+1 in collaboration with an architect, with a focus on creating larger and more comfortable spaces.
Currently, the apartment consists of a living room with kitchen, a main bedroom (Master Bedroom) with a separate dressing room (Walk-in Closet), one bathroom, one WC and a balcony.

The reorganisation of the floor plan has given the bedroom more space and functionality, while the integrated dressing room creates a cleaner and more practical division of the space.
The apartment is fully furnished and ready to move in.

The area of 76m² is net, while the property transfer process is carried out at the notary.
The price of the property is €91,200.
